headline.title: [Sample] Offshore wind farm joins the grid as renewables pass 20% for the first time
headline.summary: In this fictional sample story, a gigawatt-class offshore wind farm completes grid connection, lifting the renewable share of generation above one fifth this quarter. Battery storage came online at the same time to smooth the afternoon peak.
headline.why: It marks the shift from building capacity to keeping supply stable.
headline.original_title: Offshore wind farm connects, renewables top 20%

brief: [Sample data] A new offshore wind farm lifts renewables above 20% of generation. A tool maker ships a small AI model that runs offline. A biotech firm reports early data on a new vaccine carrier.

items.title: [Sample] Mirror Lake AI unveils a 3B model built for offline laptops
items.summary: The fictional company released a 3-billion-parameter language model that it says runs smoothly on a laptop without a GPU. Benchmark scores are close to a previous-generation 7B model.
items.why: Smaller, stronger models make private on-device AI practical.
items.original_title: Mirror Lake AI unveils 3B model for offline laptops

items.title: [Sample] Survey: six in ten dev teams now use AI coding assistants every day
items.summary: A sample annual survey finds most teams use an AI coding assistant at least weekly, but only three in ten have written review guidelines for it.
items.why: Tooling adoption is outrunning process, and risk management is the next gap.
items.original_title: Survey: 60% of dev teams use AI coding assistants daily

items.title: [Sample] Open-source multimodal search kit handles mixed text and image queries
items.summary: The new kit indexes documents, images and tables together. The author provides a ten-line quick-start example.
items.why: A low-friction option for small teams building internal knowledge bases.

items.title: [Sample] Study: adding a counter-example to the prompt reduces summary hallucinations
items.summary: In a sample experiment, including one deliberately wrong example cut fabricated facts in summaries by about a third.
items.why: You can improve quality without touching the model, which suits automation pipelines.

items.title: [Sample] Workflow platform adds failure-retry and alert templates
items.summary: Built-in templates now back off and retry when an API call fails, then send a push notification after three failures.
items.why: Unattended schedules fail silently; templates like this are worth adopting as-is.
items.original_title: Workflow platform adds retry and alert templates

items.title: [Sample] RSS makes a comeback as a low-cost personal news feed
items.summary: A sample essay argues that RSS plus automatic summaries is the simplest way to avoid algorithmic feeds, and lists common de-duplication tactics.
items.why: The barrier to a self-hosted news feed keeps falling.
items.original_title: Why RSS is back for personal news feeds

items.title: [Sample] Time-zone traps in scheduled jobs: when daylight saving causes double runs
items.summary: Three cases where time-zone settings caused duplicate or skipped runs, with advice to store UTC and set the display zone explicitly.
items.why: Anything that publishes at a fixed local time needs this care.

items.title: [Sample] Cypress Bio reports phase 1 data for a new mRNA vaccine carrier
items.summary: Sample data show higher antibody levels and less injection-site discomfort in a small trial. The company plans a phase 2 study next year.
items.why: The delivery carrier is the bottleneck for mRNA drugs; improvements widen what they can treat.
items.original_title: Cypress Bio reports phase 1 carrier data

items.title: [Sample] Sequencing costs fall again: a whole genome now under $200
items.summary: A sample report says a new-generation sequencer pushes per-person whole-genome cost below $200, making it viable for checkup packages.

items.title: [Sample] Gut microbiome study links high-fiber diets with better sleep
items.summary: A small observational study found slightly better sleep efficiency among high-fiber eaters, but the authors stress the sample is limited and the link is not causal.
items.why: A reminder that correlation is not causation.
items.original_title: Gut microbiome and sleep quality: early study

items.title: [Sample] Regional climate summit closes with a shipping decarbonization roadmap
items.summary: In this fictional story, several countries sign a roadmap aiming for new vessels to run on low-carbon fuels within ten years.
items.why: Shipping is hard to decarbonize, and the deal affects global supply-chain costs.
items.original_title: Climate summit closes with shipping roadmap

items.title: [Sample] A European country passes a data-portability law
items.summary: The law requires large platforms to offer exports in a standard format, with fines up to 2% of revenue for violations.
items.why: Portability lowers the cost of switching services.

items.title: [Sample] Global energy outlook: oil demand growth to slow next year
items.summary: A sample forecast says rising EV adoption will make next year’s oil demand growth smaller than this year’s.
items.why: Energy prices feed into inflation and exchange rates.
items.original_title: Oil demand growth to slow next year

items.title: [Sample] City marathon opens registration; 30,000 spots gone in ten minutes
items.summary: The sample “Example City Marathon” opened sign-ups, the system briefly choked, and organizers promised an extra afternoon wave.
items.why: Registration systems remain an annual pain point for big races.
items.original_title: City marathon sells out in ten minutes

items.title: [Sample] Pro basketball: home team rallies in the fourth for a one-point win
items.summary: The home side went on a 9–2 run in the final two minutes to win by a single point.
items.why: The race for seeding is heating up.
items.original_title: Home team rallies for one-point win

items.title: [Sample] Sports science: periodized training works better for amateur runners
items.summary: A controlled study found amateur runners on periodized plans improved their 10K times more on average.
items.why: How you schedule training matters more than simply adding volume.
